># Description
>
>  In order to improve our testing and make it more efficient, this PR adds a few testing-related skills and docs:
>
>  - .agents/skills/
>    - automate-integration-test: Converts a manual test case description into a Ginkgo v2 integration test, following project conventions (runner methods, assertion helpers, test images).
>    - check-test-coverage: Analyzes oc-mirror CLI feature coverage across integration and e2e tests, producing a gap report with prioritized recommendations.
>    - migrate-e2e-to-integration: Migrates an e2e test case to the integration suite, translating framework patterns (registry, invocation, assertions) and presenting a detailed plan before implementation.
>  - docs/testing/
>    - README.md: Documents the oc-mirror testing strategy — testing levels (unit, integration, e2e), their purpose, and guidelines.
>  - .agents/commands/
> - Moved from .claude/commands/ to .agents/commands/ to consolidate all agent configuration under .agents/.
>
